name: howto
title: The NOCO GB40 in five minutes
sub: Four steps from dead battery to running engine, from NOCO's instructions as seen in search snippets
footer: Source: NOCO GB40 user guide and support pages (not opened in full); read the manual that came in your box.

items.head: Switch everything off
items.body: Headlights, radio and A/C off in the dead car. Park nose to nose only if you must; the NOCO needs no second car.

items.head: Clamp on
items.body: Red clamp to the positive post, black clamp to the negative post or bare metal ground.

items.head: Press Power
items.body: Check that the white Boost light is on. A solid red light means reversed clamps.

items.head: Start the car
items.body: Most start at once; some need the boost connected up to 30 seconds. Wait 20–30 seconds before a retry.

items.head: Remove the clamps
items.body: Disconnect and keep the unit. No more than 5 jumps in 15 minutes, then rest it.

items.head: Recharge it
items.body: Charge by USB, about 3 hours at 2A. Top up every few months; do not leave it empty for a year.
